definition: Source contributing the earliest reliable observed IMV timestamp
description: Exact tied minima are represented explicitly
value_labels: intubation_procedure = item 224385 | invasive_ventilation_procedure = item 225792 | derived_ventilation_episode = official InvasiveVent episode | multiple_sources_same_time = two or more exact tied minima | missing = no robust timestamp
derivation_or_transformation: Assigned from the robust source or sources at first_observed_imv_time
validation_rules: must be missing only when all robust times are missing and multiple_sources_same_time only for exact tied minima
notes: Nonmissing categorical field; missing is an explicit category

definition: Indicator that at least one robust IMV timestamp source is present
description: Presence flag independent of the broad legacy chart regex
value_labels: 0 = no robust timestamp | 1 = at least one robust timestamp
derivation_or_transformation: Any nonmissing value across the three robust source timestamps
validation_rules: must be nonmissing and equal 1 exactly when first_observed_imv_time is nonmissing
notes: Restricted row-level flag; aggregate summaries only

definition: Mutually exclusive temporal classification relative to qualifying_pco2_time
description: Strict timestamp ordering with no rounding buffer or tolerance
value_labels: not_applicable_no_qualifying_gas = no qualifying gas | no_observed_imv = no robust legacy or untimed official-source evidence | qualifying_gas_before_imv = gas timestamp is strictly earlier | imv_before_qualifying_gas = robust IMV timestamp is strictly earlier | timing_indeterminate = missing or tied timing legacy-only evidence or an official IMV source record without a usable timestamp
derivation_or_transformation: Classified from pco2_threshold_any qualifying_pco2_time robust_imv_observed first_observed_imv_time legacy imv_flag and source-derived untimed evidence verified through the required private MIMICIV IMV source provenance.json sidecar
validation_rules: must be nonmissing; gas-positive rows must partition exactly into four analysis strata; ICD-only rows must be not_applicable_no_qualifying_gas; exact ties and verified untimed official-source-only evidence must be timing_indeterminate; reject incorrect untimed relabeling in both directions
notes: Temporal order is noncausal and must not be labeled iatrogenic ventilator-induced or new-onset; the internal flag is absent from all Excel exports and the sidecar remains restricted

definition: Nullable indicator that observed IMV strictly preceded the qualifying gas
description: Convenience field derived from the temporal classification
value_labels: True = imv_before_qualifying_gas | False = no_observed_imv or qualifying_gas_before_imv
derivation_or_transformation: True for imv_before_qualifying_gas; False for no_observed_imv or qualifying_gas_before_imv; NA otherwise
validation_rules: must match imv_qualifying_gas_order exactly
notes: Restricted row-level flag; aggregate summaries only

definition: Nullable indicator defining gas-positive admissions with no observed IMV before the qualifying gas

derivation_or_transformation: True for no_observed_imv or qualifying_gas_before_imv; False for imv_before_qualifying_gas; NA otherwise
validation_rules: must match imv_qualifying_gas_order and exclude timing_indeterminate from the sensitivity cohort
notes: Restricted row-level flag; aggregate summaries only

readable_name: Hours from IMV to qualifying gas
definition: Signed elapsed hours from first reliable observed IMV to the qualifying gas
description: Negative values mean gas before observed IMV and positive values mean observed IMV before gas
derivation_or_transformation: (qualifying_pco2_time - first_observed_imv_time).total_seconds() / 3600
validation_rules: sign must agree with the strict temporal class; zero must be an exact tie classified timing_indeterminate; missing when either timestamp is missing
notes: Restricted row-level interval; aggregate distribution only

definition: Indicator of material robust-versus-legacy disagreement in IMV presence or comparable ordering

validation_rules: must be nonmissing and binary; missing legacy timing alone must not be flagged as discordance
notes: Does not permit legacy timing to define the new subgroup
